name: Travis W. Drayna
research_summary: Drayna's listed publications concern computational methods for hypersonic flows, including flow solvers and refining the meshes used in simulations. His work also examines simulation accuracy and the use of fluid-dynamics models in guidance and control of hypersonic vehicles.
